description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class 'AuthenticationServiceTest' for testing the 'AuthenticationService' in the OrangeHRM system. It includes multiple test methods to verify credential setting behavior under various conditions, mock dependencies, and ensure proper handling of user statuses and termination states.

classes.name: AuthenticationServiceTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class that verifies the behavior of the AuthenticationService class, focusing on credential validation, user status checks, and integration with user data and session management.

methods.name: testsSetCredentialsWithInvalidCredentials
methods.description: Tests behavior when provided credentials do not correspond to any user.

methods.name: testsSetCredentialsWithNotAssignedEss
methods.description: Verifies handling when user is of role 'ESS' but not assigned to an employee.

methods.name: testsSetCredentialsWithDisabledUser
methods.description: Checks that disabled users trigger the appropriate exception.

methods.name: testsSetCredentialsWithTerminatedEmployee
methods.description: Ensures terminated employees are correctly identified and an exception is thrown.

methods.name: testsSetCredentialsWithoutEmployee
methods.description: Verifies behavior when user does not have an associated Employee entity.

methods.name: testsSetCredentials
methods.description: Tests successful credential setting and session updates for a valid user.
